testcase.name: Stateless frames (cancellation is the caller's): evaluation order does not matter; a stopped effect is one the caller no longer evaluates; BEFORE, ACTIVE-but-empty and AFTER (ended) are distinct
Signed zeros in inputs do not change positions: -0.0 anchor and point coordinates, -0.0 phase, give the same values (compared with ==) as +0.0
Extreme magnitudes: anchors at |x| = 3e7 (world border) and 1e15, scales 1e-9 and 1e9, subnormal and huge local offsets stay finite and match the oracle within the tolerance
Overlapping animations: 200 layers with the same timing, geometry and style but different motions are all emitted, in insertion order, each with its own pose
0 and 1 samples: shapes from M4 sample sets of 0 and 1 points; a 0-point layer is never emitted; a 1-point layer is a single exact placement
Inactive layers never leak: across 2,000 instants of the four example scenes, a batch exists only for ACTIVE layers or AFTER layers with HOLD_AFTER, and only inside the scene window
